_meta.description: Connect to 100 different cloud storage accounts on your Apple device with seamless Finder and Files integration, encrypted backups, and automated sync.
_title: Enter Space - All Your Cloud Storage, One Place
a-heartfelt-thank-you.6098ec: A heartfelt thank you to the many early supporters who purchased Enter Space before this pricing change. You believed in the app early on, and that means the world to me. As a token of gratitude, all existing purchasers enjoy Grandfathered access — you will continue to have full, unrestricted access to Enter Space without ever needing to subscribe or make an additional purchase. Your original purchase is honored, no strings attached.
a-refreshed-macos-menu.c7a66c: A refreshed macOS menu-bar experience: a quick-add button for new storage, Settings and Help in their own windows that stay out of your way, and a Home tab that puts favorites, recently played media, and scheduled syncs front and center on every device.
absolutely-enter-space-offers.dab5ac: Absolutely! Enter Space offers a free 7-day trial with full access to every feature — no restrictions, no credit card required upfront. This gives you plenty of time to connect your cloud accounts, set up syncs, and see how Enter Space fits into your workflow before deciding on a plan.
add-and-edit-remote.34bd67: Add and edit remote configurations through a simple, guided visual interface. No command line required—get connected in just a few taps.
all-plans-support-apple.46b41c: All plans support Apple Family Sharing — one subscription covers your entire family.
all-your-cloud-storage.ac8483: All Your Cloud Storage, One Place
an-apple-photos-style.e29b8d: An Apple-Photos-style library over any of your remotes: year/month/day timeline, Places map, Albums, Favorites, and full-text search. Live Photos play on hold, RAW files open as true RAW develops, and 360° shots get an interactive look-around viewer. Everything indexes into a private, encrypted on-device library that syncs to your other devices serverlessly — and any photo, video, or album can be downloaded for fully offline use, encrypted at rest.
apple-tvs-typically-live.dfe906: Apple TVs typically live in shared spaces, so by default any remote you've marked hidden stays hidden on every TV. When someone taps "Show Hidden Remotes" on a TV, an unlock request is sent to your iPhone or Mac and a push notification appears with Approve and Deny actions — even if the app is force-quit. Tap Approve, authenticate with Face ID / Touch ID, and hidden remotes appear on that one TV for the next 3 hours.
approve-apple-tv-unlocks.48d3d5: Approve Apple TV Unlocks from Your Phone
automatically-skip-scheduled-syncs.c490e: Automatically skip scheduled syncs when on battery power or connected to low-data or costly networks. Save battery life and avoid unexpected data charges.
back-up-your-entire.9d76da: Back up your entire Photos library to any cloud provider. Protect your precious memories with automated, secure photo backups.
backup-directories-optionally-config.dd5: Backup directories — Optionally configure a backup directory so that files replaced or deleted during a sync are preserved rather than permanently lost.
bisync-two-way-sync.cf8a09: Bisync — Two-way sync that keeps both source and destination in sync with each other, propagating changes in both directions.
blaine-miller-all-rights.b327c2: © Blaine Miller. All rights reserved.
browse-through-your-version.b498c7: Browse through your version history from any snapshot's point of view. Restore files and folders as needed with intuitive time-travel navigation.
built-on-rclone-s.4cbbc4: Built on Rclone's proven open-source technology with years of community testing and security audits. Fast, reliable, and secure cloud access you can trust.
built-on-the-proven.ec36e2: Built on the proven open-source Rclone CLI with a track record of reliability. Fast, efficient, and communicates directly with cloud providers.
can-i-perform-file.b26009: Can I perform file operations within the app?
can-i-try-enter.93729b: Can I try Enter Space before committing?
cloud-remotes-and-local.ebe0b9: Cloud remotes and local folders now live together in one tidy Storage list — combined actions, per-item encryption toggles, and a one-tap sort that flips between alphabetical and most-recently-used.
configure-automated-sync-operations.886f: Configure automated sync operations to keep your important files backed up across multiple cloud providers. Schedule syncs to run in the background, ensuring your data is always safe.
connect-to-100-different.4be71c: Connect to 100 different cloud storage accounts on your iPhone, iPad, and Mac. Seamless integration with Finder and Files app, end-to-end encryption, and automated backups powered by proven open-source technology.
connect-to-virtually-any.0dd9ec: Connect to virtually any cloud storage service including Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, iCloud, S3, and 95 more providers all in one place.
copy-copies-new-and.4d30d7: Copy — Copies new and changed files from source to destination without deleting anything at the destination.
default-on-icloud-sync.350460: Default-on iCloud sync replicates your rclone configs, SSH keys, and Personal Access Tokens across your Apple devices. Prefer device-only? One toggle keeps every new credential local.
direct-integration-with-finder.583e4b: Direct integration with Finder on Mac and Files app on iOS via File Provider. Access all your clouds like native storage with full read/write support.
drag-and-drop-files.b40b4c: Drag and drop files, use Spotlight search, and work with your cloud files using any app—just like they're stored locally. Full read and write support for the majority of supported clouds.
drill-into-any-cloud.1acf58: Drill into any cloud or local storage location and see exactly which folders are eating your space. Sorted biggest first, recursive multi-select to clear it all out in one pass.
duplicate-tasks-quickly-duplicate.f81a76: Duplicate tasks — Quickly duplicate an existing scheduled sync task to set up a backup to an additional location. All settings, filters, and options are copied so you can reuse your existing configuration without starting from scratch.
each-apple-tv-is.0b99b4: Each Apple TV is paired by name. The first time you unlock a TV you're asked to confirm the name it claimed for itself, which then locks on the TV — so another device on your iCloud account can't register a TV with the same name to trick you into approving the wrong one. Confirmed TVs show up cleanly in the unlock list; unconfirmed ones are flagged with an "Unconfirmed" pill.
each-scheduled-sync-task.701273: Each scheduled sync task can be configured with a range of options:
edit-a-webpage-in.ae34a4: Edit a webpage in the editor and watch it render live alongside — every script, image, and stylesheet loading like the real thing. Auto-refreshes the moment you save.
edit-code-with-syntax.a9b2cb: Edit code with syntax highlighting, code folding, comprehensive find and replace, draft versioning, and follow mode for watching logs in real-time.
edit-only-providers-configure.867ac3: Edit-only providers (configure via rclone.conf; not shown in the in-app Add Remote picker because of vendor sandbox/auth quirks, but fully editable and usable once present):
enjoy-full-feature-parity.a40439: Enjoy full feature parity across all your devices with a native interface tailored to each platform. Start a sync on your Mac, check progress on your iPhone, browse files on your iPad—your cloud storage moves seamlessly with you. One purchase unlocks Enter Space everywhere.
enter-space-also-keeps.989b7a: Enter Space also keeps detailed logs from the last 50 scheduled sync executions, so you can review exactly what happened during each run — including files transferred, errors encountered, and overall sync statistics.
enter-space-includes-a.e83bf5: Enter Space includes a powerful built-in code editor with syntax highlighting for dozens of languages, code folding, line numbers, and intelligent formatting—everything you need for a quick, enjoyable editing experience wherever you are. Perfect for reviewing scripts, making quick fixes, or diving into configuration files right from your cloud storage.
enter-space-integrates-directly.cf0237: Enter Space integrates directly with macOS Finder and iOS Files app through File Provider technology. Access all 100 cloud storage providers as if they were native drives on your device.
enter-space-is-a.3bcc75: Enter Space is a paid app — the entire app requires an active subscription or a one-time lifetime purchase to use. There is no free tier or partially unlocked mode. After your 7-day free trial, you can choose the plan that works best for you:
enter-space-is-a.7be22b: Enter Space is a true universal app built from the ground up for the entire Apple ecosystem. Whether you're on your iPhone, iPad, or Mac, you get the complete experience—no compromises, no missing features, no second-class platforms.
enter-space-is-designed.23f2f5: Enter Space is designed so that recovering from a lost or broken Mac is as painless as possible. Most of your Enter Space settings are automatically saved to your iCloud account, and sensitive credentials like remote access tokens and passwords are securely stored in your iCloud Keychain.
enter-space-is-monitoring.7a5ed5: *Enter Space is monitoring the features of FSKit and has plans to integrate with that framework once Apple has brought it to a maturity state ready for Network FileSystems.
enter-space-isn-t.99328e: Enter Space isn't sold on the App Store in the European Union — under the EU Digital Services Act, selling there requires publishing a trader listing with personal contact details, which I've opted out of as an independent developer. It's available in every other App Store territory.
enter-space-offers-several.172ef6: Enter Space offers several types of automated sync operations to keep your data backed up:
enter-space-provides-the.6bb9d2: Enter Space provides the client, but beyond that it is up to you to use cloud storage providers you trust. Your credentials are stored locally in your device's Keychain (and synced via iCloud Keychain if enabled), and your files travel directly between your device and your chosen provider — never through us.
enter-space-s-whole.1f163f: Enter Space's whole feature surface, automatable: copy, move, rename, upload, download, and share files; recover versions through Time Portal; run Doppel duplicate scans and Space Inspector reports; commit and push Git changes; create and run scheduled syncs — all chainable, with time, location, and Focus triggers via Shortcuts automations. Secrets can never be read or written.
enter-space-supports-all.145cb0: Enter Space supports all of Rclone's well-supported cloud storage providers:
enter-space-uses-apple.2ae262: Enter Space uses Apple's File Provider framework to integrate directly with the Files app on iOS and Finder on macOS. Your cloud storage appears as a location in Files/Finder, allowing you to access files with any app that supports file browsing.
every-plan-includes-the.751147: Every plan includes the full Enter Space experience — no features held back
every-storage-location-now.5d70c7: Every storage location now carries a thin used/free capacity bar — cloud remotes and linked local folders alike — color-coded as space runs low, with the full readout a long-press away. Make it yours in Settings: hide the bars or switch them to a calm monochrome.
experience-everything-enter-space.2bd6f1: Experience everything Enter Space has to offer with a free 7-day trial. Then choose the plan that works for you — monthly, yearly, or a one-time lifetime purchase. All plans support Family Sharing.
filtering-include-or-exclude.58e5c0: Filtering — Include or exclude files using path wildcard patterns, modification timestamps, or file sizes. Filters can be applied in an inclusive or exclusive manner, giving you precise control over exactly which files are synced.
find-files-by-what.0f523f: Find files by what's INSIDE them, straight from system Spotlight — text, Markdown, source code, and PDFs in local sources are content-indexed, and cloud sources are searchable by name. Privacy is built in: hidden content is never indexed and encrypted remotes stay out of Spotlight by default, with per-source toggles in Settings.
four-starfield-styled-widgets.57f6b5: Four starfield-styled widgets for iPhone, iPad, and Mac: a Photo Slideshow of your favorites, a Storage Dashboard with per-location used/free bars and provider icons, a Bandwidth monitor, and a Sync Status board for your scheduled syncs. Tap any one to jump straight into the app — a widget photo opens that exact frame in the gallery slideshow, a sync opens its run-results detail.
generate-shareable-public-links.d55212: Generate shareable public links for files and folders on supported cloud providers. Share your content instantly without leaving the app.
hidden-remotes-stay-hidden.c1090d: Hidden remotes stay hidden on the Apple TV by default. When someone taps "Show Hidden Remotes" on the TV, your iPhone or Mac gets a push notification with Approve / Deny buttons — even if the app's force-quit. Tap Approve, Face ID, done. Each TV is paired by name so an imposter device can't trick you into approving the wrong one. Tap Lock from the phone and the TV snaps back to the locked home grid instantly, even mid-playback.
host-your-remote-content.2616d7: Host your remote content locally with the Serve feature supporting WebDAV, NFS, FTP, S3, SFTP, HTTP, DLNA, and Restic. NFS is significantly faster than WebDAV for media playback over encrypted cloud remotes because macOS's NFS client skips the per-file metadata probes Finder's WebDAV client does.
hover-swipe-or-tap.49b6ae: Hover, swipe, or tap any node. Each one's a feature in progress or just over the horizon.
how-do-i-recover.52f36e: How do I recover my setup on a new or replacement Mac?
how-does-enter-space.ac2e67: How does Enter Space handle my privacy?
how-does-the-apple.85450d: How does the Apple TV hidden-remotes unlock work?
how-does-the-files.102e68: How does the Files app integration work?
icloud-file-materialization-when.7c7312: iCloud file materialization — When syncing iCloud Drive directories, Enter Space will automatically materialize (download) evicted files before the sync runs and re-evict them afterward. This lets you back up your full iCloud Documents even if the files aren't actively present on your device.
if-you-run-into.07a3b1: If you run into any issues during your trial (or at any point after subscribing), please don't hesitate to reach out to me. I'm happy to help troubleshoot and resolve any problems. Fixing issues for you makes the app better for everyone.
immerse-yourself-in-360.e28aaa: Immerse yourself in 360° and 180° photos and videos streamed directly from your cloud storage. Explore panoramic and spatial media with intuitive controls.
inspect-and-debug-web.318577: Inspect and debug web content with a built-in developer console for the in-app browser. View logs, errors, and network activity without leaving the app.
is-my-data-secure.cb1d55: Is my data secure with end-to-end encryption?
lock-files-on-supported.f17e75: Lock files on supported cloud providers to prevent accidental edits or deletions. Keep critical files safe with collaborative locking support.
more-features-more-platforms.ad2088: More features, more platforms, flexible pricing
move-moves-files-from.c56c62: Move — Moves files from source to destination, removing them from the source after a successful transfer.
need-to-browse-media.7443d4: Need to browse media? The integrated gallery beautifully displays images and videos from any folder, complete with smooth slideshow functionality. Preview your photos, watch videos, and navigate through your media collection without leaving the app—your cloud files have never been more accessible.
network-awareness-automatically-skip.6fb: Network awareness — Automatically skip syncs when on battery power, low-data networks
on-macos-webdav-ftp.99e18e: On macOS, WebDAV, FTP, and NFS serves can be automatically mounted into your filesystem with the Mount Helper App, giving you an alternative way to browse and manage your cloud files alongside the standard File Provider integration. NFS in particular is dramatically faster than WebDAV for media playback over encrypted cloud remotes because macOS's NFS client doesn't probe every file the way Finder's WebDAV client does — and NFS mounts land under ~/Library/Application Support/Enter Space/Mounts/ instead of /Volumes/ so Spotlight doesn't try to index your entire cloud tree.
optionally-share-your-remote.6da255: Optionally share your remote configurations with the rclone command line through a shared rclone.conf file. Power users can seamlessly switch between the visual interface and terminal workflows.
pay-once-use-forever.87c60c: Pay once, use forever — no recurring fees
perfect-for-backing-up.a989b7: Perfect for backing up photos, documents, and important files. Works on iPhone, iPad, and Mac with flexible subscription options or a one-time lifetime purchase.
photos-backup-automatically-backs.0ce9f7: Photos Backup — Automatically backs up media from your Photos library. Choose to export photos, videos, or both, and optionally preserve metadata via sidecar files. You can export the original unedited version, the edited version, or both. Only new or changed media items are exported, so subsequent runs are fast and incremental.
photos-library-your-photos.b84cd0: Photos Library — Your Photos, Any Cloud
pick-up-where-you.5d6a0c: Pick up where you left off on any device. Your recently played media syncs across iPhone, iPad, and Mac so you never lose your place.
pin-any-folder-of.005d53: Pin any folder of any remote and Enter Space keeps a complete local copy — encrypted at rest — that refreshes automatically in the background. When the remote can't be reached, you can still browse and preview the downloaded copy, with a per-pin Wi-Fi Only toggle to protect your data plan.
pin-your-most-used.cb7496: Pin your most-used folders for instant access. Favorite folders stay front and center across all your devices for quick navigation.
play-legacy-flash-swf.1bcc5b: Play legacy Flash SWF files directly within the app. Revisit classic Flash content and animations without needing a separate player or browser plugin.
plus-rclone-wrapper-types.1e73b2: Plus Rclone wrapper types for advanced workflows:
point-theater-at-your.613d1f: Point Theater at your movie and TV folders and get Netflix-style shelves with artwork and details from TMDB — or no key at all, and it builds your library from your file names. Continue Watching follows you across iPhone, Mac, and Apple TV; episodes auto-advance; resume never spoils. A custom player built for real-world files means audio and subtitle track choices actually switch and are remembered — across resume, episodes, launches, and devices. Download whole seasons for offline viewing, encrypted on-device.
pull-a-remote-folder.cc9c9c: Pull a remote folder down as a local Git working copy, edit with your normal toolchain, push the changes back to the cloud. No mount required, no manual sync.
rate-limit-tuning-set.b645af: Rate-limit tuning — Set a transactions-per-second cap and low-level retry count to stay within a provider's limits (great for backends like pCloud with dynamic, unpredictable throttling). If a destination keeps rate-limiting, the sync detects the repeated limit and aborts cleanly with a clear message instead of hammering away.
rclone-is-a-battle.194a88: Rclone is a battle-tested open-source command-line tool for managing cloud storage. It's been around for years with a proven track record of reliability and security. Enter Space is built on Rclone, giving you the power of this trusted tool with a beautiful native Apple interface.
ready-for-ios-27.5181f1: ✓ Ready for iOS 27 / iPadOS 27 / macOS 27 / tvOS 27
remote-configurations-your-configure.3bd: Remote configurations — Your configured cloud storage remotes and their connection settings.
right-click-a-file.0a1851: Right-click a file in Finder or share from any app — Enter Space opens it in the code editor, gallery, or sends it via Secure Drop. Native share extensions on iPhone, iPad, and Mac.
schedule-automated-sync-operations.459b2: Schedule automated sync operations with advanced filtering and incremental backups. Supports near realtime file change monitoring so your data syncs moments after it changes. Keep your data safe across all devices with smart, efficient transfers.
schedule-options-set-syncs.cec558: Schedule options — Set syncs to run on custom intervals, or use near-realtime file monitoring to sync moments after changes are detected. They can even be triggered from Apple Shortcuts
scheduled-sync-tasks-all.5fc3d9: Scheduled sync tasks — All of your automated sync configurations, schedules, and filtering rules.
secrets-and-credentials-access.6f7d83: Secrets and credentials — Access tokens, passwords, and API keys are stored in iCloud Keychain for end-to-end encrypted sync across your devices.
serve-configurations-any-file.41d228: Serve configurations — Any file serving setups you've created (e.g., WebDAV, SFTP, HTTP servers).
set-custom-environment-variables.c48005: Set custom environment variables for fine-grained control over Rclone behavior and cloud provider configurations. Tailor your setup to match advanced workflows.
share-files-and-folders.f5ad59: Share files and folders with end-to-end encryption built on Rclone's Crypt. Data is encrypted before it leaves your device, and the recipient decrypts it using a web-based decryption tool with a password you share outside of the storage provider — adding an extra layer of privacy even if the shared link is compromised.
slideshows-advance-on-their.a9e754: Slideshows advance on their own when a track ends, look-alike photos are de-duplicated before they reach your wrist, VR/360 media is skipped (the watch can't project it), and watch copies are never larger than the original. Background transfers pause while you're watching or listening, so playback stays smooth.
spot-near-identical-photos.a4314c: Spot near-identical photos, videos, and audio across every connected cloud. Sees through resizes, format swaps, and re-edits — and warns you when one looks watermarked so you keep the clean original.
stage-commit-push-pull.6d045f: Stage, commit, push, pull, branch — full Git workflow built into the editor. SSH keys on Mac and HTTPS auto-token on iPhone, so the same SSH-form remote URL just works on every device.
start-with-a-free.00ecae: Start with a free 7-day trial — no commitment, full access to everything.
stream-your-cloud-stored.c8c930: Stream your cloud-stored media directly to Apple TV. Enjoy your videos, photos, and audio on the big screen with seamless AirPlay integration.
switch-tabs-close-the.f3c049: Switch tabs, close the editor, force-quit the app — your unsaved work is captured automatically and waiting for you next time. No "discard changes?" surprises.
sync-makes-the-destination.3eb83c: Sync — Makes the destination match the source, copying new and changed files and deleting files from the destination that are no longer in the source.
sync-your-cloud-media.997111: Sync your cloud media to your wrist. A media-first Apple Watch companion browses your synced library and plays it back right from the watch — with background audio so your music keeps going. A watch-face photo complication flips through a folder you choose (tap it to open that photo, turn the Digital Crown to zoom), and it adapts to tinted faces so your photos stay legible. Everything's stored encrypted at rest, with the media key delivered securely from your paired iPhone.
take-a-closer-look.bec0b1: Take a closer look at Enter Space in action
tap-lock-from-the.4ad63e: Tap Lock from the phone or Mac and the TV snaps back to the locked home grid immediately — within seconds — even if someone was mid-playback on hidden content. The lock signal rides Apple's CloudKit infrastructure (no server we operate), with an iCloud-key-value fallback that catches it within a couple of seconds if the push gets delayed.
the-current-introductory-pricing.c5d41c: The current introductory pricing is available for a limited time, and no additional sales are planned after this period. Pricing is subject to change as features and market conditions evolve. All plans — including subscriptions and the lifetime purchase — support Apple Family Sharing, so one purchase can cover your entire family.
the-entire-app-requires.dae500: The entire app requires an active subscription or lifetime purchase — there is no free tier or partial access. Current introductory pricing is available for a limited time. No additional sales are planned after this introductory period. Pricing is subject to change as features and market conditions evolve.
the-following-are-persisted.ed33b4: The following are persisted to your iCloud account and will be available on your new device:
the-optional-enter-space.2abcca: The optional Enter Space Mount Helper App auto-mounts a WebDAV, FTP, or NFS Serve as a local folder with zero password prompts. NFS mounts land under ~/Library/Application Support/Enter Space/Mounts/ instead of /Volumes/ so Spotlight doesn't try to index your entire cloud tree.
the-serve-feature-lets.1e9dfa: The Serve feature lets you spin up a local server that exposes any of your configured remotes using a variety of Rclone serve types — including WebDAV, NFS, FTP, SFTP, HTTP, S3, DLNA, and Restic. This is useful for accessing your cloud files through other apps or devices on your network.
theater-a-private-streaming.2bbfba: Theater — A Private Streaming Service for Your Files
unified-cloud-storage-management.2d6190: Unified cloud storage management with enterprise-grade security
view-photos-watch-videos.c7fca0: View photos, watch videos, and listen to audio directly from your cloud storage with background playback support. Video plays in Enter Space's own player — Liquid Glass controls, AirPlay, playback speed, and audio/subtitle menus that work reliably with multi-track files. Your media, always accessible.
what-about-users-who.66d619: What about users who already purchased Enter Space?
what-is-rclone-and.19e99a: What is Rclone and why is it important?
what-types-of-automated.e82dc4: What types of automated syncs are available?
when-you-sign-into.3ed033: When you sign into your iCloud account on a new Mac and install Enter Space, your previous settings will be securely restored — in most cases automatically. This means you can get back to a fully working backup setup without manually re-entering credentials or recreating your sync tasks from scratch.
which-cloud-storage-providers.8aad23: Which cloud storage providers are supported?
while-enter-space-can.fddc5a: While Enter Space can connect to over 100 cloud storage providers, the app runs entirely on your device. It connects directly from the app to your configured providers — Enter Space does not monitor, track, or even route your data through any intermediary servers. This means Enter Space has zero insight into how you use the app or what data you store, ensuring the utmost privacy.
yes-enter-space-can.68ee9d: Yes! Enter Space can use Rclone's Crypt remote wrapper, which is built on XChaCha20-Poly1305 — an encryption algorithm that is highly efficient and that some researchers have attributed as being theoretically post-quantum resilient. When using a remote wrapped in the crypt type your files are encrypted entirely on your device before they're uploaded to the cloud, meaning only you can decrypt and access your data — even if the cloud provider or someone else gains access to your cloud account.
yes-enter-space-includes.7a89f3: Yes! Enter Space includes basic file operations like copy, move, delete, rename, and create folders directly within the app. You can also use these operations through the Files app integration.
your-apple-watch-favorites.2d73e7: Your Apple Watch favorites and hidden items, your recently-played list, and your exact playback position now follow you from device to device through your private iCloud — pick a track or photo back up right where you left off.
your-data-is-encrypted.0f816b: Your data is encrypted before it leaves your device, ensuring maximum security and privacy across all your cloud storage accounts.
your-files-are-encrypted.ce8455: Your files are encrypted on your device before they're uploaded to the cloud. Enter Space uses end-to-end encryption to ensure only you can access your data, even if the cloud provider is compromised.
